movie:10361.overview: Brigitte has escaped the confines of Bailey Downs but she's not alone. Another werewolf is tailing her closely and her sister's specter haunts her. movie:1212461.title: Obex

movie:13061.tagline: HISTORY FROM THE P.O.V OF RATS. *disclaimer*

movie:14061.tagline: The only thing more dangerous than war... is love.
